question:
How many words
do you need to know?
french_original:
Il était une fois un gentilhomme
qui épousa, en secondes noces, une
femme, la plus hautaine et la plus
fière qu'on eût jamais vue.
french_adapted: Une jeune fille habite avec son père et sa belle-mère. Sa belle-mère a deux filles, dures et jalouses.
translation_original: Once upon a time, a gentleman took as his second wife the haughtiest, proudest woman anyone had ever seen.
translation_adapted: A young girl lives with her father and her stepmother. Her stepmother has two daughters, who are harsh and jealous.
